claim: Our light stage (bloodmap.light_stage.run) never cuts a mover's host sector for light and shadow, so in Gravesend a mover set straight into a big lit street would leave a hole in the street's lighting; the carousel on the square (2026-11-25) was given its own thin ring of the street's sector (an apron, 0.22 of a plan unit) between it and the street.
evidence: Gravesend's carousel on the square, 2026-11-25: projects/blood-city/level/fair.py:25, 42-43 (APRON = 0.22)
bloodmap/light_stage.py:1296-1311 (run): a sector swept_state.hosts names is lit but never cut
use: Wrap every mover placed in a large open sector in an apron ring.

checked.how: Opened projects/blood-city/level/fair.py:25 ('The host is a ring of the street's own (APRON)'), :42-43 APRON = 0.22 'what a mover stands in is not cut up by light and shadow'; bloodmap/light_stage.py:1296-1311 (run): swept_state.hosts are added to 'whole', 'lit but never cut'. So the uncut host is our light stage's rule, not Blood's.
